core.settings.organisation.short-name.he: Used where space is tight, such as text messages and the passkey prompt.
core.settings.organisation.country.label: Country
core.settings.organisation.country.help: The country the theatre is in. Public holidays are taken from it.
core.settings.organisation.contact-email: A public address for the theatre, such as boxoffice@example.org. Use a shared address, not a person's own. Test emails are sent here.
core.settings.organisation.contact-phone: A public phone number for the theatre.
core.settings.organisation.address.label: Postal address
core.settings.organisation.address.help: Shown on the contact component and on receipts.
core.settings.organisation.legal-name.he: The registered name, where it differs from the theatre's name. Shown in the footer and on receipts.
core.settings.organisation.charity-numbe: Shown in the footer if the theatre is a registered charity.
core.settings.brand.accent.label: Brand colour
core.settings.brand.accent.help: The one colour everything else is worked out from. Text on it and in it is always made readable.
core.settings.brand.neutral.label: Tone of greys
core.settings.brand.neutral.help: Cool, warm or plain greys for backgrounds and borders.
core.settings.brand.display-font.label: Heading font
core.settings.brand.display-font.help: The font for headings on the public site.
core.settings.brand.radius.label: Corners
core.settings.brand.credit-line.label: Show “Powered by Proscenium”
core.settings.brand.credit-line.help: A small line in the public footer.
core.settings.brand.logo.label: Logo
core.settings.brand.logo.help: Your logo, uploaded and checked. Set on the brand screen.
core.settings.brand.logo-dark.label: Logo for dark mode
core.settings.brand.logo-dark.help: An optional second logo for dark backgrounds. Set on the brand screen.
core.settings.brand.revision.label: Brand revision
core.settings.brand.revision.help: Raised each time the brand is saved, so browsers fetch the new look. Kept by the system.
core.settings.files.image-limit.label: Largest image upload
core.settings.files.image-limit.help: The biggest image a person can upload.
core.settings.files.document-limit.label: Largest document upload
core.settings.files.document-limit.help: The biggest document a person can upload.
core.settings.files.brand-limit.label: Largest logo upload
core.settings.files.brand-limit.help: The biggest logo file accepted, before it is cleaned.
core.settings.files.deleted-retention.he: How long a removed or replaced file can be restored before it is gone for good.
core.settings.files.upload-timeout.label: Give up on an upload after
core.settings.files.upload-timeout.help: An upload that has not been checked after this long is refused.
core.settings.notifications.sending-doma: The domain email comes from, such as example.org. It must be set up for sending in Cloudflare. No email is sent until it is set and verified.
core.settings.notifications.verified-dom: The sending domain that last passed a test message. Kept by the system.
core.settings.notifications.email-footer: Text under every email, such as a registered address.
core.settings.notifications.sending-labe: The word put before the site's address when the sending domain is set up automatically. With "mail", a site at example.org sends from mail.example.org.
core.settings.rules.country-code: The country is a two-letter code in capitals, such as GB.
core.settings.rules.contact-email: The contact email is not an email address.
core.settings.rules.sending-domain: The sending domain is a domain name in lower case, such as example.org.
core.settings.rules.sending-label: The sending label is one part of a domain name in lower case, such as mail.

core.settings.rules.year-end: The year end is a month and a day that falls in every year, written as MM-DD, such as 07-31.

core.settings.rules.stuck-after: Treat as stuck after must be longer than the wait before the first retry.
